```{r}
# Load packages and functions from setup script
source(
  here::here(
    "3-scripts",
    "0-setup.r"
  )
)

pbs_sites <- get_wq_sites(study_area)

```

Retrieve WQ data using study-area sites and selected parameters

```{r}
salinity_raw <- get_wq_data(
  param = "Salinity",
  from_date = "2005-01-01",
  to_date = "2025-01-01",
  sites = pbs_sites,
  output_name = "salinity",
  force = FALSE
)

water_temp_raw <- get_wq_data(
  param = "Temperature, water",
  from_date = "2005-01-01",
  to_date = "2025-01-01",
  sites = pbs_sites,
  output_name = "water_temp",
  force = FALSE
)

do_raw <- get_wq_data(
  param = "Dissolved oxygen (DO)",
  from_date = "2005-01-01",
  to_date = "2025-01-01",
  sites = pbs_sites,
  output_name = "do_mgL",
  force = FALSE
)

chl_a_raw <- get_wq_data(
  param = "Chlorophyll a, corrected for pheophytin",
  from_date = "1995-01-01",
  to_date = "2025-01-01",
  sites = pbs_sites,
  output_name = "chl_a_mgL",
  force = TRUE
)

turbidity_raw <- get_wq_data(
  param = "Turbidity",
  from_date = "2005-01-01",
  to_date = "2025-01-01",
  sites = pbs_sites,
  output_name = "turbidity",
  force = FALSE
)
```

```{r}

# Process WQ datasets

salinity_proc <- proc_wq_data(salinity_raw)
do_proc <- proc_wq_data(do_raw)

turbidity_proc <- proc_wq_data(turbidity_raw)
water_temp_proc <- proc_wq_data(water_temp_raw)

```

Check histogram and spatial distribution

```{r}
wq_summary <- bind_rows(
  salinity_proc %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(parameter = "Salinity (ppt)"),
  do_proc %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(parameter = "Dissolved Oxygen (mg/L)"),
  chla_proc %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(parameter = "Chlorophyll-a (µg/L)"),
  turbidity_proc %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(parameter = "Turbidity (FTU)"),
  water_temp_raw %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(parameter = "Temperature (°C)")
)
```


## Chlorophyll-a

TODO: Investigate new cleaning method to remove sampling bias. Look to require minimum number of sampling years to remove one off sampling events.

```{r}
# Retrieve Data 
chl_a_raw <- get_wq_data(
  param = "Chlorophyll a, corrected for pheophytin",
  from_date = "1900-01-01",
  to_date = "2025-01-01",
  sites = pbs_sites,
  output_name = "chl_a_mgL",
  force = TRUE
)

# Process Data
chl_a_proc <- proc_wq_data(chl_a_raw)

# View Distribution of Mean
ggplot(chla_proc, aes(x = mean)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 20,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Warm-Season Chl-a Observations",
    subtitle = "Sample Counts for monitoring locations in the Pensacola Bay System",
    x = "Observed Mean",
    y = "Number of Monitoring Locations"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )


# View Spatial Distribution
chl_a_map <-
  tm_basemap("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") +
  tm_shape(chla_proc) +
  tm_dots(
    fill = "mean",
    col = "black",
    size = 0.5,
    lwd = 0.5,
    fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous(
      values ="scico.imola"),
  ) +
  tm_legend(
      position = c("left", "top")
    ) +  
  tm_layout(
    inner.margins = c(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
  ) +
  tm_title("Chlorophyll-a (mg/L) - Observed Means") +
  tm_compass(type = "8star") 

chl_a_map

```


## Salinity

```{r}
salinity_raw <- get_wq_data(
  param = "Salinity",
  from_date = "2005-01-01",
  to_date = "2025-01-01",
  sites = pbs_sites,
  output_name = "salinity",
  force = TRUE
)

```
```{r}
# Process Data
sal_proc <- proc_wq_data(salinity_raw)

# View Distribution of Mean
ggplot(sal_proc, aes(x = mean)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 20,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Warm-Season Salinity Observations",
    subtitle = "Sample Counts for monitoring locations in the Pensacola Bay System",
    x = "Observed Mean",
    y = "Number of Monitoring Locations"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )


# View Spatial Distribution

param_means_map(sal_proc, "Salinity", "PPT")

```
